3090-3752-8193.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Phage.
3090-3752-8193.description:
Donate control of Avacyn to an opponent using Harmless Offering.
Kill Phage by any method.
At the beginning of the next end step, Avacyn triggers, returning Phage from your graveyard to the battlefield under the opponent's control.
When Phage enters, its first ability triggers, causing the opponent to lose the game.

1008-1978-2392.easyPrerequisites: Undermountain Adventurer doesn't have summoning sickness.

141-653-8095.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-653-8095.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2511-2728-6012-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2511-2728-6012-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2511-2728-6012-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 4.

654-1308-2557-4365-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

475-4186-6996-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-4186-6996-7810.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

232-4772-5778-6867.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, its innate ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the innate Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}
Resolve the offspring trigger, creating two token copies of Priest of Urabrask that are 1/1.
When the Priest of Urabrask tokens enter, they each trigger, adding six {R}.
Cast Appa by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Appa enters, its innate ability and its offspring ability trigger.
Resolve the innate Appa trigger, airbending the nontoken Priest of Urabrask.
Resolve the offspring trigger, creating two token copies of Appa that are 1/1.
Put both Appa tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Both Appa tokens' enter-the-battlefield ability trigger, airbending Appa with one trigger and nothing with the other.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat steps 2 through 5 once.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat from step 7.
232-4772-5778-6867.notes: Once you have extra mana, other nonland permanents can be airbended using Appa and returned to the battlefield each loop as desired.

618-4456-6091-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {1}{R} due to Archmage of Runes.
Archmage of Ruins and Hematite Talisman trigger.
Resolve the Archmage of Ruins trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Hematite Talisman trigger, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

64-1987-7089.notablePrerequisites: You control three permanents that enter untapped and that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
64-1987-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate three permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting the tapped permanent and Warden of the Eye.
Fire Lord Azula triggers, copying Ghostly Flicker, targeting two other mana-producing permanents
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking the two targeted permanents.
Resolve the original Ghostly Flicker, blinking the targeted permanent and Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

560-1563-1879-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1308-3809-4682-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
1308-3809-4682-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create two Treasure tokens due to Anointed Procession.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Repeat.
1308-3809-4682-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

2366-3430-5702-7060.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3430-5702-7060.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3129-3899-4324-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Workshop Elders.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1247-6723-7008.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {1}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1778-2438-4053-6989.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Memnite.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

539-2292-3045-3293.easyPrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
539-2292-3045-3293.description:
Cast any creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters as a Plains due to Ashaya and Emeria Shepherd, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature cast in step 1.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
539-2292-3045-3293.notes: You can forego step 3 as long as two or more creature cards are in your graveyard. This allows you to reanimate all creature cards in your graveyard if you wish.

1669-4056-4679--82.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Second Wind attached to the mana-producing creature, then untapping Yenna and causing you to scry 2.
Activate the Second Wind token's second ability by tapping it, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing the Second Wind token.
Repeat.
1669-4056-4679--82.notes: If the creature being tapped for mana can add {3} or more, this combo will net infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

1796-2511-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
1796-2511-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
1796-2511-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

803-997-1789-5649.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
803-997-1789-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-3951-5703-5744.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
2438-3951-5703-5744.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

803-1429-5226-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
803-1429-5226-5402.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist.

3388-5686--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, it triggers its persist ability, returning itself to the battlefield as a copy of the creature with persist with two +1/+1 counters and one -1/-1 counter on it.
Remove one +1/+1 counter and one -1/-1 counter from Moritte of the Frost as a state-based action.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1013-1170-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}.
1013-1170-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Hypervolt Grasp by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Peregrine Drake.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Hypervolt Grasp spell.
Activate Hypervolt Grasp by paying {1}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1734-4050-4605-5144.description:
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Preston.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, choosing not to exile a creature.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 white Illusion.
The Fiend Hunter token enters the battlefield, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter.
Activate Phyrexian Altar sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token, adding one mana of any color.
The token dies, returning the nontoken Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

802-1810-2649-3581.manaNeeded: {U}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
802-1810-2649-3581.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional non-Human nonlegendary creature.
You control two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{W/U}.
802-1810-2649-3581.description:
Activate two lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W/U}.
Cast Vadrok either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R} and commander tax, if applicable, putting it under any other nonlegendary non-Human creature you control.
Vadrok triggers, casting Cackling Counterpart from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve Cackling Counterpart, creating a copy of the Vadrok mutated creature.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve Snap, returning the mutated creature that contains the nontoken Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand and untapping two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{W/U}.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
Activate two lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W/U}.
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, putting it under the token Vadrok mutated creature.
The nontoken and token Vadrok each trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Vadrok trigger, casting Cackling Counterpart from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve Cackling Counterpart, creating a copy of the Vadrok mutated creature.
Resolve the token Vadrok trigger from step 13, casting Snap from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve Snap, returning the  mutated creature that contains the nontoken Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand and untapping two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{W/U}.
Activate Kykar twice by sacrificing two Spirits, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 12.
With each iteration, you will gain an additional Vadrok trigger, which you can use to cast any other noncreature spells with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard, and create infinite Spirit tokens due to Kykar.

2099-2267-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in your graveyard.
2099-2267-5256.description:
Activate Sarcatog's first ability by exiling two cards from your graveyard.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve Sarcatog's ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Zombie token, causing yourself to mill cards equal to the Zombie's power.
Repeat.
